Antea Poland is a leader in providing advanced engineering and consulting services. It belongs to the global ANTEA Group.
Antea Group is an international engineering and environmental consulting firm specializing in full-service solutions in the fields ofenergy, environment,infrastructure,urban planning, andwater. By combining strategic thinking, multidisciplinary perspectives and technical expertise, we do more than effectively solve client challenges we deliver sustainable results for a better future. With more than 3.200 employees in90 offices around the world, we serve clients ranging from global energy companies and manufacturers to national governments and local municipalities.
Antea Poland with its more than 25 years of experience on the domestic and international market provides engineering and consulting services in the field of energy, gas, industry and infrastructure. The specialist knowledge of our experts and innovative solutions guarantee the highest quality of services provided to the private and public sector. 
The company was established in 1992 under the name of CITEC S.A., then it was transformed into Tractebel Engineering S.A. In May 2019 it became a part of the Antea Group, changing its name to Antea Polska S.A. Thanks to the employment of high-class professionals, the company quickly gained a leading position in the water and sewage services market, while taking a place in the leading Polish engineering companies in this branch.
For the needs of the market, in 2006 the company started intensive development of its activity in the energy sector, which allowed it to build a strong position as a provider of engineering and consulting services in the field of conventional energy, transmission and distribution of electricity, and renewable energy. For several years Antea Polska has also been one of the main suppliers of services in the design of high pressure pipelines, gas facilities and LNG systems, thus contributing to the improvement of the country's energy security. Since its inception, Antea Polska has played a strategic role in supporting both public and private sector customers and its success is due to the emphasis on innovative solutions that contribute to the implementation of effective solutions.
Scope of works:
A wide range of activities, apart from energy and gas, also includes services for industry and infrastructure, hydrotechnics and waste management.
Drawing on the experience of an international team of consultants and engineers, Antea Polska offers full project management at every stage of project implementation, from concept and feasibility studies, through the preparation of complete tender and design documentation, to Contract Engineer service, construction management and technical consulting, as well as afull range of other engineering services according to the requirements of the project and the needs of the clients.

entityName: TECHNISCHE UNIVERSITAT DRESDEN - Environmental Remote Sensing
entityDescription: The Junior Professorship in Environmental Remote Sensing was established in September 2019 and was designed as the future successor of the Chair of Remote Sensing at TU Dresden. The group (JProf. Matthias Forkel) conducts research on the application and development of satellite data sets and derived products to observe, analyse, model and predict changes in vegetation and the related impacts on the carbon and water cycle, and on vegetation fires. Thereby a focus is on the use of microwave satellite instruments such as passive microwave radiometers and radars (Sentinel-1) to characterise changes in vegetation moisture content, phenology and productivity. The group has profound experiences in the use and development of time series analysis methods, machine learning, global fire-enabled dynamic global vegetation models, and model-data integration techniques.

entityDescription: MIO-ECSDE is a non-profit Federation of 130 Mediterranean NGOs working in the fields of Environment and Development in 25 countries of the Euro-Mediterranean area. MIO-ECSDE acts as a technical and political platform for the intervention of NGOs in the Euro-Mediterranean scene on nature and biodiversity, resources and waste, health and environment, climate change, cultural diversity as well as on horizontal and cross-cutting issues. MIO-ECSDE is certified for meeting ISO 9001:2015 standards in the design, development, management and implementation of international and European projects on environment and sustainable development and it is committed to a high standard of transparency, accountability and effectiveness and is a signatory of the Accountable Now. MIO-ECSDE’s highest decision-making body is the Annual General Assembly, where its Member Organizations come together to decide on the work programme, the strategic priorities and budget. The core of MIO-ECSDE is its Secretariat Team based in Athens, the Executive Bureau and its NGO Member Organizations. MIO-ECSDE has been recognised as a key international player in skilfully bringing together Mediterranean stakeholders on issues crucial for the sustainable future of the region. MIO-ECSDE facilitates four more networks of major Mediterranean stakeholders who play a key role in addressing the region’s environmental and sustainable development challenges: a network of Educators (MEdIES), a network of Parliamentarians (COMPSUD), a network of Journalists (COMJESD), a network of Universities (MedUnNet).

entityDescription:
Raytheon Technologies (NYSE: RTX) is an aerospace and defense company that provides advanced systems and services for commercial, military and government customers worldwide. The company was formed in 2020 through the combination of Raytheon Company and the United Technologies Corporation aerospace businesses, and is headquartered in Waltham, Massachusetts.
Raytheon Technologies has over 195,000 employees globally, 60,000 of whom are Engineers, with 2019 pro forma combined annual revenue of $74B. The company is very proud of its 190+ years of combined innovation and industry leadership, with a portfolio of over 40,000 patents. Raytheon Technologies is defining the future of aerospace and defense, with ambitions technologies that push the limits of known science. Annual company- and customer-funded research and development is approximately $8B.
In Europe, Raytheon Technologies has over 25,000 employees, with significant design centers and manufacturing sites in Poland, France, Germany, Italy and the United Kingdom. 
Within its Technology and Global Engineering organisation, Raytheon Technologies operates a Corporate Research Centre, chartered with research and early development of critical technologies applicable to multiple businesses. This organization works with technology leaders across the company to develop an impactful corporate research portfolio and ensure efficient transition of technologies to the businesses. The Research Centre has a global footprint with locations in East Hartford, CT, Berkeley CA, Cork, Ireland, and Rome, Italy. It has approximately 500 employees, more than 400 of whom are professional scientists and engineers. 
United Technologies Research Centre Ireland, Ltd. (UTRC-I) is an affiliate of Raytheon Technologies. It was established in Cork in 2010 to operate as Raytheon Technologies European research hub, with a mission to develop advanced technologies – “what’s next” – for all the businesses of Raytheon Technologies, particularly those based in Europe, and to work with other industry, national labs and academic institutions to broaden the scope and impact of new technology developments along the value chain. 
In Ireland, the Research Center has approximately 75 employees who investigate the “what ifs” of power distribution, advanced propulsion, energy storage, autonomy and human-machine interaction and innovative aircraft systems. This application focus, coupled with the extensive experience of the Research Centre in system engineering, controls, modelling, formal methods, and embedded system development, its close-knit interaction with the diversity of Raytheon Technologies’ European businesses, ideally place the Research Center to lead participation in European research projects.

Its modularity, compact size, 8-hour autonomy and great range, make it an ideal drone for highly demanding missions, such as reconnaissance, surveillance and data collection. Operational on All Terrains

entityDescription:
Quantum Reversal Inc. (QR) operates in the information and wireless technology sector. QR develops an innovative wireless and antenna technologies for various commercial markets. The QR team has experience in designing products for various applications in space, underwater, robotics, UAV to commercial and user end. Each application requires specific solution in order to deal with specific environmental (i.e. pressure, temperature, vibration) and operational conditions. 
 
QR has developed a proprietary solution for an intentional jamming and unintentional RF interference of the GPS/GNSS signals in order to provide a robust GPS or GNSS navigation solution services such as timing and/or 3D position. The commercial market is the main target of QR novel anti-jamming products.
 
The current solution consists now of five products: 
· QR100 – GPS dual frequency L1/L2 anti-jamming unit
· QR200 – GPS dual frequency L1/L2 anti-jamming antenna
· QR101 – GNSS multi frequency bands anti-jamming unit
· QR201 – GNSS multi frequency bands anti-jamming antenna 
· QR202 – GNSS multi frequency band anti-jamming antenna with additional L-band reception (1520-1560 MHz)
 
All the products are lightweight (230 grams for QR1xx series and 500 grams for QR2xx series), low power consumption (1-1.5 Watt typical depend on the configuration) that are suitable to be mounted on any platform (cars, poles, drones, etc.).
 
The company sells stand alone products as well as OEM products that can be integrated within the customer products.
